title: Pat the Map
lines: I am Tam. Sam and Pam sat.
The map! Pat the map, Sam.
Tap the map, Pam. Tap, tap, tap.
Tam, Sam and Pam tap at the map.
As I tap, Sam and Pam pat.

questions.listenFor: Tam. The first line says "I am Tam." If they are unsure, ask them who the word I means here.

questions.ask: What are Tam, Sam and Pam patting and tapping?
questions.listenFor: The map. It is in nearly every line — let them find one and read it back to you.

questions.ask: A rolled-up map will not lie flat. What would you do to it? Show me.
questions.listenFor: Any idea of their own. Patting it flat is what the children do, but smoothing it, holding the corners or kneeling on the edge are all good thinking.
